caption:
Sunlight hits your pillow before your alarm even tries.

Most bedroom windows get hit hardest right at sunrise, and thin or short curtains don't stand a chance against it. Light leaks in around the edges and straight through the fabric, so the room never really goes dark.

These are blackout panels, two to a set, cut wide and long enough to cover a full bedroom window instead of leaving gaps on either side. The idea is simple: less fabric gap, less light getting through.

A room that can actually go dark when you want it to, without swapping out your whole window setup, and it runs about $10.
